---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(readr)
library(yaml)
library(htmltools)
source("R/utils_catalogue_ui.R")
activities <- read_csv("data/metadata/catalogue_activites.csv", show_col_types=FALSE)
activities$filter_duration <- editorial_duration(activities$duration)
cat('<section class="activities-page catalogue-editorial" id="catalogue-activites" data-resource-catalogue="activite">',
    '<header><h1>Planifier une activité</h1><p>Trouver une activité selon sa durée, son niveau et les notions abordées.</p></header>')
catalogue_controls('activite', nrow(activities), list(
  list(name='duration',label='Durée',values=activities$filter_duration),
  list(name='level',label='Niveau',values=activities$level),
  list(name='concept',label='Notion',values=catalogue_tokens(activities$concepts)),
  list(name='use',label='Format',values=activities$recommended_use),
  list(name='context',label='Thème',values=activities$context)))
cat('<div class="act-grid" data-catalogue-results>')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(activities))) {
  row <- activities[i, ]
  item <- read_yaml(sub('[.]qmd$','.yml',row$activity_url))
  href <- sub('[.]qmd$','.html',row$activity_url)
  status <- switch(row$pedagogical_status,pret_a_enseigner='Fichiers inclus',a_consolider='Acquisition préalable',ebauche='Ébauche')
  minimum <- as.numeric(sub('^([0-9]+).*','\\1',row$filter_duration))
  if (grepl('heure',row$filter_duration)) minimum <- minimum*60
  attrs <- catalogue_attributes(c(title=row$title,duration=row$filter_duration,minutes=minimum,
    level=row$level,concept=paste(catalogue_tokens(row$concepts),collapse='||'),
    use=row$recommended_use,context=row$context,
    search=paste(row$title,row$question,row$dataset_title,row$concepts,row$search_aliases,row$context,item$expected_output)))
  cat('<article class="act-card" data-catalogue-card',attrs,'>',resource_type_badge('activite'),
      '<div class="act-card-meta"><span>',catalogue_escape(row$duration),'</span><span>',catalogue_escape(row$level),
      '</span><span>',catalogue_escape(status),'</span></div>',
      '<h2><a href="',catalogue_escape(href),'">',catalogue_escape(row$title),'</a></h2>',
      '<p class="act-card-question">',catalogue_escape(row$question),'</p>',
      '<p class="act-card-output">À produire : ',catalogue_escape(item$expected_output),'</p>',
      '<p class="act-card-prerequisites">Prérequis : ',catalogue_escape(editorial_sentences(item$prerequisites)), '</p>',
      '<a class="act-card-action" href="',catalogue_escape(href),'">Consulter l’activité</a></article>',sep='')
}
cat('</div><p class="act-empty" data-empty-catalogue hidden>Aucune activité ne correspond aux filtres actuels.</p></section>')
```

## Modules transversaux {#modules-transversaux}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Preserve the existing module destinations and titles from their source pages.
for (path in list.files('activities',pattern='[.]qmd$',recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)) {
  front <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(path)
  cat('<p><a href="',catalogue_escape(sub('[.]qmd$','.html',path)),'">',catalogue_escape(front$title),'</a></p>',sep='')
}
```
